findings.message: The purification method omits the specified silica gel, and the petroleum ether/EtOAc eluent conditions are retained only in evidence. Specify silica gel chromatography in method and preserve the eluent details in unmapped_actions because the closed Purify schema has no eluent fields.

value.reason: Chromatography eluent and ratio range are specified, but the closed Purify schema has no fields for these conditions.
